title: MUSE Inspire Conference
summary: eFax is heading to the Windy City for the 2026 MUSE Inspire Conference, the premier gathering for MEDITECH users, taking place May 19-22. We understand the specific needs of the MEDITECH community, and we’re ready to showcase how eFax integrates seamlessly to transform unstructured data into actionable clinical insights. Stop by Booth #313 at the Hyatt Regency Chicago to see our AI-native data transformation tools in action. We’ll show you how to automate your inbound document workflows, ensure 100% HIPAA compliance, and enhance your MEDITECH ecosystem with secure, digital faxing that simplifies interoperability for hospitals of all sizes.
